record.question: Which film won Most Awards in 91st Academy Awards?
record.explanation: Answer A: Bohemian Rhapsody. The Academy’s 2019 winners list gives Bohemian Rhapsody four wins: Actor in a Leading Role, Film Editing, Sound Editing and Sound Mixing. Green Book and Roma each won three, and Free Solo won Documentary Feature. Four is the largest total among the printed films and at this ceremony. Historical/source note: The 91 st ceremony took place in 2019 and honored films from the preceding eligibility year; nominations are not being counted as wins. Reference: https://www.oscars.org/oscars/ceremonies/2019/G. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
